Crighton (by vote of the town) that the town of Lynnfield be authorized to impose a local sales tax upon restaurant meals originating within said town.  Revenue.  [Local Approval Received.]

bill.title: An Act authorizing the town of Lynnfield to impose a local sales tax upon restaurant meals originating within the town

action.description: Committee reported that the matter be placed in the Orders of the Day for the next sitting

posted_text:
🛒 MA H5417 — Lynnfield Could Add a New Tax on Restaurant Meals

The town of Lynnfield can now charge a 1.5% sales tax on restaurant meals served within its borders, impacting customers and restaurants that sell food directly in the town – the tax goes to the state, but Lynnfield collects it.

July 13, 2026: Committee reported that the matter be placed in the Orders of the Day for the next sitting.

🔗 Read the full bill: https://malegislature.gov/Bills/194/H5417
